propositions: a real-world ticket store copy must be used in live verification to surface realistic volume, field-mapping defects, and link-graph ordering defects that empty-store passes cannot
the copied store must be isolated by using a fresh git repo with no remotes as the primary mechanism, combined with disabling push and scrubbing jira ids and reconciler artifacts
bidirectional reconciliation must be proven live with operator-attested round-trip mutations in both directions, each individually asserted against the instance
pagination must be observed and measured rather than assumed, with the server's effective page size discovered at runtime and at least 2*observed+1 issues seeded to force multiple pages
the suite must discriminate product defects from test defects by splitting assertions that can fail for multiple reasons and proving oracles red-first before accepting green
